sources.title: Aperant: apps/desktop/src/main/terminal/cli-integration-handler.ts
sources.locator: invokeClaude at lines 1012-1106; buildClaudeShellCommand at lines 254-300; resumeClaude at 1126 onward
sources.finding: The terminal adapter builds a Claude CLI shell command, writes it to the PTY and resumes via claude --continue. This establishes Claude Code terminal integration, separately from the task pipeline.

sources.title: Aperant: apps/desktop/src/main/ai/client/factory.ts
sources.finding: The inspected development snapshot builds an Aperant agent client with provider, tools, security and MCP. Provider choices here are not evidence of integrated Codex or Gemini CLI harnesses.

sources.title: Aperant: apps/desktop/src/main/sentry.ts
sources.finding: When a DSN is configured, the packaged main process initializes Sentry; sentryEnabled defaults true and beforeSend drops events when it is disabled. Forks without a DSN do not send.

sources.title: Aperant: apps/desktop/src/renderer/components/onboarding/PrivacyStep.tsx
sources.finding: The onboarding error-reporting switch defaults true, persists sentryEnabled and signals the active Sentry state.
